729260101.text: You must've been very skilled before.

729260102.text: Hahaha, you praise me excessively. Right now, I'm nothing more than a servant of the Kamisato Clan. At best, I had some experience when I was still young...

729260103.text: ...How about I give this to you. As you have no place to call home, some experience from this elderly servant may be of use to you.
